decisions.reason: The same-message INTRODUCE already records personal client approval and the restriction to posting approved clips; the quota reduction requires no further change to this Requirement.
Reducing the monthly clip quota does not necessarily change the deferred Lead Clipper role, its $2,000 compensation, or its advancement pathway.
The confirmed production offer follows qualification but does not modify the qualification method, corrective-clip criterion, or deadline.
The monthly quota decision does not change the task-local channel or content used for submitting sample clips for review.
The same-message INTRODUCE already records that client-approved clips are posted to the dedicated Instagram account; the quota reduction adds no publishing-state change.
The approval-based quota counting rule does not alter the substantive standard requiring complete standalone lessons or stories.
The source decision changes the monthly quantity and counting rule, not the permitted source content for clips.
The requirement for clean, simple editing remains unchanged by the quota reduction and approval-counting rule.
The source message does not change caption color, font, or effects requirements.
The change from 125 to 100 approved clips does not modify the required 30-to-90-second duration range.
The quota and approval-counting decision does not alter the standard for selecting strong, impactful source moments.
